name: Steps
description: Ordered wizard navigation with persistent content panels; form validation belongs to the consumer.

items.description: Ordered step definitions. An omitted or empty list renders no navigation.

step.description: Controlled nonnegative integer index; displayed within the current item bounds.

defaultStep.description: Initial uncontrolled index; later changes are ignored. Defaults to 0.

linear.description: Allow only the current, earlier or immediately next step. Does not validate forms.

disabled.description: Disable step navigation; the visible panel remains usable.

membrane.description: Membrane spacing around each step control. Defaults to true.

behavior.selection: Zero-based position; controlled changes are quiet, user changes emit one proposal.
behavior.linear: Only current, earlier or next position. Form validation and approval belong to the controlled parent.
behavior.disabled: Disables navigation only; current content stays usable.
behavior.panels: Inactive panels remain mounted and hidden; their form fields still participate in form data.
behavior.items: Use stable unique keys when inserting, removing or reordering stateful panels. Keys do not change index-based selection.

keyboard.Tab: Move between enabled step buttons and visible content controls.
keyboard.Enter / Space: Request the focused step; preventDefault in key capture cancels native activation.

notes: Name the root with aria-label or aria-labelledby; defaults to Steps.
An ordered list communicates step order. Number indicators are decorative.
Existing panels are named by their button and referenced with aria-controls. Hidden panels are excluded from focus and the accessibility tree.
Step buttons use shared control geometry and the canonical Membrane.
Numeric indicators use the same CSS geometry for all step counts.
Primitive panels use Text with inherited alignment; custom children retain their own styles.
